prompt:
Produce the requested compact final artifact. Use the simplest behavior consistent with the public specification and pick a reasonable convention where it is silent. Keep private deliberation short.
Public specification:
Create a set of counters suitable for use as a 12-hour clock (with am/pm indicator). Your counters are clocked by a fast-running clk, with a pulse on ena whenever your clock should increment (i.e., once per second, while "clk" is much faster than once per second). The signal "pm" is asserted if the clock is PM, or is otherwise AM. hh, mm, and ss are two BCD (Binary-Coded Decimal) digits each for hours (01-12), minutes (00-59), and seconds (00-59). Reset is the active high synchronous signal that resets the clock to "12:00 AM." Reset has higher priority than enable and can occur even when not enabled.

Treat this document as behavioral evidence. Follow the artifact and interface instructions in this request when the release describes testbench scaffolding or coverage goals.
Public interface: input widths {'reset': 1, 'ena': 1}; output widths {'pm': 1, 'hh': 8, 'mm': 8, 'ss': 8}.
Frozen timing: Clock clk; driven input row before the posedge sample, sampled after that edge settles. Optional mid changes inputs after this sample, before the other edge. The next row drives new inputs before the next sample.
Work independently from this public spec. Write concise concrete directed scenarios as JSON, with no executable model and no reasoning prose. A scenario starts at power-up; make reset/initialization explicit when possible. Cover reset and release where present, control combinations and precedence, width and value boundaries and all specified behaviors. Keep each scene <=20 cycles and all scenes <=120. Typical suite: 4–7 short scenes, kept as short as possible. Use a short exact verbatim spec substring per scene. Format: {"scenes":[{"id":"s1","spec_quote":"exact text","covers":["behavior","boundary"],"cycles":[{"in":{input:integer},optional "mid":{input:integer},"out":{output:integer}}]}]}. Use the coverage tags reset, priority, boundary, behavior. Write bit patterns as unsigned integer values.
Use brief private deliberation. Prioritize the complete artifact before the token limit.
